external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Rock Dental Brands is a progressive practice management group, started by dentists, that provides support to general and dental specialists affiliates, including Westrock Orthodontics, Birmingham Orthodontics, Baptiste Orthodontics, Coastline Orthodontics, Leap Kids Dental, Rock Family Dental and Impact Oral Surgery and a host of other independent brands.
